g.text: A second market orders from what already exists.
Same example, carried forward. Market one produced the seasonal launch film. Market two wants it in their language, in their formats, with their legal line and their promotion.
A duplicate of work already done,
at close to full cost and close to full timeline, producing something that is a near neighbour of an asset already sitting in the DAM.
THE PATH THAT REPLACES IT · ORDERING
market two looks for what already exists,
in the system they already use
six of the nine components carry straight
the two AI tasks named in the
same approval gate as every other route
and registered back, so market three
orders from a larger set again
The order is a form, not a brief.
What can be ordered is exactly what the production record says already exists. Nobody writes a creative
brief, nobody schedules a shoot, and nobody has to know the first market’s production history to place the order.
This works from day one for everything produced in the system.
It does not work, on its own, for the assets
already sitting in your DAM from before the engagement, because those have no production record and no component breakdown.
That gap is the next slide, and it is the single largest open item in this section.
TECHNOLOGY SECTION · STORYBOARD FOR NARRATIVE AGREEMENT
